why: The kernel oom log timestamps the kill at 21:33:35Z and names pid 5349, the exact pid the 49financial command's own stderr reported as 'Killed python3 $R/holdings_snapshot.py --firms 49financial --upload --qa' (surprise row IRPT_BCKEND-W42-S2). Not measured here: whether cottonwood/inflection's now-exited processes left any freed-but-not-yet-reclaimed memory behind, or what 49financial's peak RSS would be run alone with nothing else ever concurrent -- the concurrency window that did exist (21:29:07Z-~21:31:30Z) ended roughly two minutes before the kill, which is the measured basis for OOM-SINGLE over OOM-CONCURRENT.
